AGENDA

340 Palos Verdes Drive West  November 12, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

Upon request, the agenda can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a
disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk’s
office at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification
or accommodation.

The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
November 25, 2014. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the
Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person
must ask the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item
from the Consent Calendar for discussion.

CALL TO ORDER

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety
Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  November 12, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, King, Leach and Vice-Chair Kao, present.
  Chairman Buss absent (previously notified).

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 Malaga Cove Parking – Ray Burns

  Action:  No action at this time – ongoing item.

  Lunada Bay Plaza Parking – Wayne Inman

  Action:  No action at this time.

OLD BUSINESS
1. All-way stop control at Via Coronel and Via Zurita

  Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Leach) to recommend that Staff: 1) Not install all-way stop controls at the
  intersection of Via Coronel and Via Zurita; and, 2) Install and modify traffic control devices
  in the vicinity of the intersection as recommended by the City Traffic Engineer. The vote was
  4 in favor (Buss absent).

2. Traffic Study on Via Segunda at Via Campesina

  Traffic Safety Committee member King moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee Vice-
  Chair Kao) to recommend that Staff obtain additional traffic volume data on Via Segunda
  and return to the Committee. The vote was 4 in favor (Buss absent).

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, November 25, 2014.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director SR-L
Action Memo
November 12, 2014
 3. Update on Via Almar traffic calming efforts

  Traffic Safety Committee member Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend that Staff: 1) Maintain the traffic calming devices that were
  installed on Via Almar; and, 2) Continue rotating the radar speed feedback signs to the two
  Via Almar locations. The vote was 4 in favor (Buss absent).

NEW BUSINESS

4. None

RESIDENT LETTERS
5. Cyclists Speeding and Failure to Abide by Traffic Laws – Taheri Rangwala

  Action:  No further action.
